subject: English
passage: In 2018, a team led by marine biologists Therese Persson and Tito Moreira succeeded in documenting the deepest-dwelling bioluminescent organism ever recorded—the abyssal jellyworm. A translucent creature (and, as its name suggests, remarkably worm-like) found at extreme ocean depths, ______
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

choices.A: when its habitat exceeds 6,000 meters deep, marine researchers classify the abyssal jellyworm.
choices.B: marine researchers, when its habitat exceeds 6,000 meters deep, classify the abyssal jellyworm.
choices.C: the abyssal jellyworm is classified when marine researchers find it below 6,000 meters.
choices.D: classifying the abyssal jellyworm occurs when marine researchers find it below 6,000 meters.

explanation: Choice C is the best answer. The subject of the modifier "a translucent creature found at extreme ocean depths" is "the abyssal jellyworm." Subject-modifier placement requires a modifier and its subject to be next to one another, so "the abyssal jellyworm" must be the first word in the missing clause.
